members.name: Fitzroy Falls
members.bio: Falls dropping over 80 m into Yarrunga Valley, seen from an accessible boardwalk near the visitor centre.

members.name: Belmore Falls
members.bio: Short walking track to lookouts over Kangaroo Valley and the falls; the base is permanently closed.

members.name: Kangaroo Valley
members.bio: Enclosed valley village of about 900 with antique shops and historic buildings, near Hampden Bridge.

members.name: Hampden Bridge
members.bio: Heritage suspension bridge over the Kangaroo River, opened in 1898 as the second built in NSW.

members.name: Fleet Air Arm Museum
members.bio: Australian naval aviation story told in a hangar-style hall at HMAS Albatross, overlooking the runway.
members.hours: Fri–Sun and public holidays 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
members.photo_file: Replica of McDonnell Douglas A-4G Skyhawk 882 at the Fleet Air Arm Museum in February 2015.jpg

members.name: Berry
members.bio: Elegant village with a heritage main street, antiques, a historic museum and the Berry Donut Van.

members.name: Seven Mile Beach National Park
members.bio: Park between Shoalhaven Heads and Gerroa for swimming, fishing, picnics and the Sand Track walk.
members.photo_file: Beach Walk, Seven Mile Beach National Park, Shoalhaven, Australia.jpg

members.name: Booderee National Park
members.bio: Park managed jointly with the Wreck Bay Aboriginal Community, with beaches, botanic gardens and a lighthouse.
members.hours: Open daily (check Parks Australia for gate and alert notices)

members.name: Hyams Beach
members.bio: Village beach on Jervis Bay beside Booderee National Park, with white sand and safe swimming.

members.name: Huskisson
members.bio: Jervis Bay's largest town, a base for dolphin and whale-watching cruises (whales June to November).
members.photo_file: Huskisson NSW 2540, Jervis Bay - Uc - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Beecroft Peninsula
members.bio: Military range peninsula open at set times, with Point Perpendicular Lighthouse at the end of a gravel road.
members.hours: Fri 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM, weekends to 6:00 PM, school and most public holidays

members.name: Pigeon House Mountain
members.bio: Steep walk with ladders near the summit, to Budawang cliffs and views as far as Jervis Bay.

members.name: Mollymook Beach
members.bio: Beach beside Ulladulla, a 45-minute walk from town, with a public golf course popular with visitors.

members.name: Pebbly Beach
members.bio: Murramarang beach with a picnic area, campground and shacks, where kangaroos may be seen on the sand.

members.name: Murramarang South Coast Walk
members.bio: A 34 km, three-day coastal walk between Ulladulla and Batemans Bay, over rock platforms at low tide.

members.name: Mogo Wildlife Park
members.bio: Zoo near Batemans Bay with red pandas, snow leopards and black-and-white ruffed lemurs.

members.name: Mogo
members.bio: Gold-rush village on the Princes Highway, 9 km south of Batemans Bay, with cafes and pie shops.

members.name: Barunguba Montague Island
members.bio: Island reserve off Narooma with hundreds of seals and 90-plus bird species, reached only by tour boat.
members.photo_file: Montague Island and lighthouse from the west.jpg

members.name: Mount Dromedary
members.bio: Mountain of spiritual significance to Aboriginal people, with mining-road walks and coastal lake views.

members.name: Central Tilba
members.bio: Preserved hill village with colourful houses, boutiques and a cheese dairy, easily covered on foot.

members.name: Bermagui
members.bio: Fishing and surfing town on the far south coast, near Blue Pool and Camel Rock beach.

members.name: Eurobodalla National Park
members.bio: Coastal park with camping, 1080 Beach surfing, Brou Lake fishing and the 14 km Bingi Dreaming track.
members.photo_file: Mystery Bay, Eurobodalla National Park, New South Wales, Australia 01.jpg

members.name: Blue Pool
members.bio: Two rock pools below a cliff, one shallow and sheltered, with views to Montague Island and free entry.

members.name: Camel Rock Beach
members.bio: Well-known surf beach reached along Moorheads and Haywards beaches from Bermagui, good for photographs.

members.name: Wallaga Lake
members.bio: Lake of Aboriginal significance for kayaking, windsurfing and black swans, with boats for hire.

members.name: Tathra
members.bio: Seaside town with a hotel and cafes, where Mimosa Rocks National Park starts at the end of its beach.

members.name: Bega
members.bio: Inland dairy town on the Sapphire Coast, home of the modest Bega Cheese Heritage Centre.

members.name: Mimosa Rocks National Park
members.bio: Headlands, beaches and lagoons running about 16 km north from Tathra, with winter whale watching.

members.name: Bournda National Park
members.bio: Park with the Kangarutha walking track, Wine Glass Bay, lagoon kayaking and Wallagoot Lake swimming.

members.name: Tathra Wharf and Museum
members.bio: Tathra's heritage wharf, last used by a ship in 1954, with a small museum beside it open weekends.
members.hours: Wharf: open 24 hours; museum Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM

members.name: Bega Cheese Heritage Centre
members.bio: Small museum of Bega's cheese and dairy history, with a cafe, tasting area and river verandah.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Sat–Sun 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (winter hours)

members.name: Green Cape Lighthouse
members.bio: NSW's southernmost lighthouse, entered only on guided tours on set dates, with open grounds.
members.hours: Grounds open 24 hours; lighthouse tours on set dates (10:00 AM)

members.name: Light to Light Walk
members.bio: A 32 km, three-day coastal walk from Boyds Tower to Green Cape Lighthouse with beachside campgrounds.
